phrase: Here's where we currently stand on the project.
useCase: Providing a general overview of current project progress
example: Here's where we currently stand on the project. We've completed the design phase and are now moving into development.
practicePrompt: You are giving a weekly project update to your team. Introduce the current status using this phrase.

phrase: We're on track to meet the deadline.
useCase: Confirming that work is progressing according to the planned schedule
example: I'm happy to report that we're on track to meet the deadline. All milestones through phase two have been delivered on time.
practicePrompt: Your manager asks how the project is going. Reassure them about the timeline using this phrase.

phrase: We've hit a slight delay due to...
useCase: Transparently reporting a minor setback while explaining the cause
example: We've hit a slight delay due to unexpected changes in the client's requirements, but we expect to recover by next week.
practicePrompt: Your project is running a few days behind. Report the delay honestly using this phrase.

useCase: Reporting specific completed milestones or deliverables
example: As of today, we've completed the user testing phase and documented all findings in the report I've shared with you.
practicePrompt: You are presenting a progress update at a stakeholder meeting. List completed items using this phrase.

phrase: The main blocker we're facing right now is...
useCase: Identifying and communicating a key obstacle that is impeding progress
example: The main blocker we're facing right now is the delay in third-party API integration. We're working with their team to resolve it.
practicePrompt: Your team is stuck on a dependency. Raise the blocker in a status meeting using this phrase.

phrase: We're about seventy percent through the implementation.
useCase: Quantifying progress with a percentage to give a clear sense of completion
example: We're about seventy percent through the implementation. The remaining work involves testing and deployment.
practicePrompt: An executive asks for a quick progress snapshot. Give a quantified update using this phrase.

phrase: I wanted to give you a quick progress update on...
useCase: Initiating a brief status update conversation or message
example: I wanted to give you a quick progress update on the marketing campaign. We've launched phase one and early metrics look promising.
practicePrompt: You're sending a Slack message or email to your manager. Open with a progress update using this phrase.

phrase: We've made significant progress since our last check-in.
useCase: Highlighting meaningful advancement since the previous reporting period
example: We've made significant progress since our last check-in. The prototype is now functional and ready for internal review.
practicePrompt: It's been two weeks since your last team sync. Highlight what's been accomplished using this phrase.

phrase: The next milestone we're working towards is...
useCase: Communicating the upcoming goal or deliverable the team is focused on
example: The next milestone we're working towards is the beta release, which is scheduled for the end of this month.
practicePrompt: You've just reported on completed work. Transition to what's coming next using this phrase.

phrase: We're currently waiting on approval from...
useCase: Explaining that progress is paused pending a decision or sign-off
example: We're currently waiting on approval from the compliance team before we can proceed with the rollout.
practicePrompt: Your project is stalled because you're waiting for a sign-off. Explain the situation using this phrase.
